versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Mattress Spec Decoder.
- Decodes mattress marketing specs into core materials science values (foam density, ILD, coil type/count/gauge).
- Recommends firmness band based on individual sleep position and BMI.
- Scores mattress durability and estimates real lifespan.
- Analyzes and decodes warranty terms, including sag-thresholds and prorated coverage.
- Enables side-by-side comparison of two mattresses using specs and user profile.
